name: Improve pi-lite coding agent local self-test responsiveness

description: baseline local build+self-test benchmark; current self-test fails because grep_files does not find the temporary file

asi.hypothesis: Establish deterministic local benchmark for agent improvements; failures should receive score 0 so correctness fixes dominate before latency tuning.
asi.baseline_observation: Built-in --self-test reports grep_files missing expected temp file; all 7 repeated runs failed.
asi.next_action_hint: Inspect grep_files_tool/git_file_manifest path handling for file pathspecs and fix smoke test without weakening checks.

description: search explicit regular files directly so grep_files works on ignored temp files in self-test

asi.hypothesis: grep_files should honor an explicit file path even when it is gitignored; avoiding git manifest filtering for regular files fixes the smoke test without weakening directory search ignore behavior.
asi.result: Self-test now passes 7/7. Also reduced median self-test latency because the failing path no longer emits extra diagnostics.
asi.next_action_hint: Now optimize local tool startup/self-test latency while preserving the passing self-test.

description: avoid git rev-parse subprocess by locating .git from the workspace before git-aware listings

asi.hypothesis: list_files pays for two git subprocesses; finding the repo root by walking parents preserves normal repo behavior while removing git rev-parse from each manifest lookup.
asi.result: Median self-test improved from 10.174ms to 7.736ms with self-test still passing.
asi.tradeoff: This handles normal repos and worktrees with a .git directory/file; exotic git discovery behavior from git rev-parse is no longer used for manifests.
asi.next_action_hint: Profile remaining time; likely one git ls-files subprocess and process startup dominate.
